notes: Frame: model metres, +X east, +Y north. Lots read from the NJ 2020 ortho (0.15 m/px) on gridded sheets; stall rows fitted to brightness profiles of the painted lines (pitch and skew by least squares, line ends from profiles along each line), checked with overlay --plan. Names from OSM parking areas (Lot 19, 21, 23, 23N, 24, 25). Lamp positions from isolated thin LiDAR returns (lidar2017 points) that sit on the pole shadows in the ortho; the 2017 cloud hits poles sparsely, so a height is the highest return on the pole, a lower bound, and is marked so. Lot 25 (east of Yogi Berra Drive, north of the District Energy Plant road): a one-way loop round a single pull-through centre row; mouths on Yogi Berra Drive (crosswalk bars across it) and on the drive north to the dorms. The south curb is one long curve, fitted as two fillets (r 21.8 and 3.2, within 0.25 m of the curb read at eight points); stalls on it fan out, so the straight part is a stalls row and the wedge lines are single lines. Lot 19 (south of the Student Recreation Center): four double rows of square stalls on painted centre lines at 22.6 to 24.1 deg, with painted hatched end caps; single rows along the west curb, the north walk (accessible stalls with 1.5 m blue access aisles) and the east curb. The south part runs past the footprint edge (y 497) and is clipped there. Divider lines found as the long bright lines on transects; stall pitch 2.59 to 2.61 m.
